summary: Implemented comprehensive Patient VIP Program Portal (Golden MetaPharm) with tier management, rewards system, exclusive offers, and points tracking - all with full test coverage (36/36 tests passing)

key_changes: VIP tier system (Silver/Gold/Platinum) with benefits and progression tracking
Points management system with transaction history
Reward cards with redemption dialogs and status tracking (Available/Pending/Redeemed/Expired)
Exclusive offers section with pagination and detailed modal view
Points history table with filtering and pagination
Tier benefits card showing current tier, benefits, discount percentage, and multiplier
Complete type-safe API service layer with error handling
Custom React hooks for membership, rewards, offers, and points history
Comprehensive component test suite with 36 tests covering all workflows

implementation_details.architecture: Feature-based modular architecture following project patterns
implementation_details.state_management: Custom React hooks with local state management and API integration
api_endpoints: GET /vip/dashboard - Get complete VIP dashboard data
GET /vip/points/history - Get points history with pagination

ui_components.TierBenefitsCard: Displays membership tier, current points, benefits, discount percentage, and multiplier. Shows progress toward next tier with upgrade button.
ui_components.RewardsSection: Grid layout of reward cards with status badges. Supports redemption dialog with optional order association. Handles loading and error states.
ui_components.OffersSection: Paginated offer cards with featured badges. Includes pagination controls and detailed modal view with terms and conditions.
ui_components.PointsHistorySection: Table view of transaction history with type badges, point values with +/- indicators, dates, and pagination.

testing_approach.unit_tests: vipService.test.ts - Tests all API service functions with mocked HTTP calls
testing_approach.integration_tests: VIPPortal.test.tsx - Tests component rendering, user interactions, and complete workflows
testing_approach.test_coverage: All components and services tested with realistic data fixtures
testing_approach.test_execution: Jest test runner with React Testing Library for component tests

code_quality.typescript: 100% strict mode compliance with full type safety
code_quality.accessibility: Material-UI components with semantic HTML and ARIA attributes
